en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a statue on a tall pedestal in the foreground, trees behind it, and a fortified hill with walls and a cross on top in the background. There is an ornate gateway in front of the fortress. Printed caption text appears below the image in French, and there is cursive handwriting along the lower edge. A web watermark with the domain 'www.elia.org.gr' is visible.
